review: This chapter separates the learning objective, representation, algorithm and evaluation contract. Similarity scores and cluster assignments are not calibrated probabilities or authoritative business decisions.
build: Run the local lab in classical mode, then optional embedding mode. Keep the split and labels fixed when comparing classifiers. For clustering, hide audit labels until fitting is complete. Add ambiguous, multi-intent and out-of-domain cases. Install the pinned optional dependencies from the contributor guide, or install numpy==2.0.2, scikit-learn==1.9.1, torch==2.14.1, sentence-transformers==6.2.0 and transformers==5.20.2 in an isolated environment. Run python text_grouping_lab.py for classical mode and add --embeddings for the real encoder; its first run downloads the pinned public model. The result JSON is the recorded tiny-fixture execution, not a production benchmark.
verify: Save configuration and model revision, per-class errors, abstention coverage and cluster/noise summaries. Reproduce a changed seed or representation and explain which conclusions survive. Local fixture results do not establish production accuracy.
